name: SALES_AI_API_KEY
label: AI provider API key
help: Anthropic API key (SALES_AI_PROVIDER=anthropic) or a Cloudflare API token with Workers AI access (SALES_AI_PROVIDER=workers-ai). Leave empty for a self-hosted OpenAI-compatible endpoint that needs no key.
setupSteps: Choose the provider in the worker's SALES_AI_PROVIDER var (anthropic / workers-ai / ollama / openai-compat) and the model in SALES_AI_MODEL.
For workers-ai, also set SALES_AI_ACCOUNT_ID (or SALES_AI_BASE_URL) so the OpenAI-compatible endpoint can be built.
Paste the key here. It is stored as a secret and never shown again.
